color: rgb(0, 0, 0) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 360px; text-align: center; width: 360px;

span.p:
Platform repository: clusters/<cell>/ · infrastructure/ · tenants/
Team repositories: apps/<app>/ · <cell>/ · placement/

div.style: color: rgb(0, 0, 0) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 360px; text-align: center; width: 360px;

span.p:
main = merged pull requests, signed by GitHub
one branch per cell, moved only by the release pipeline

div.style: color: rgb(0, 0, 0) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 360px; text-align: center; width: 360px;

span.p:
Pull request: CI validates (kustomize build, kubeconform, policy tests)
merge = the signed commit · promotion dev → acc → prd is a pull request too

div.style: color: rgb(0, 0, 0) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 360px; text-align: center; width: 360px;

span.p:
Stateful deployment pipeline
self-hosted agent · workload identity federation
checkout + verify the signature → policy gate → kubectl diff
→ approval → server-side apply → rollout checks

div.style: color: rgb(0, 0, 0) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 360px; text-align: center;

span.p:
Stateful cluster
no Flux · private API server

div.style: color: rgb(0, 0, 0) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 360px; text-align: center; width: 360px;

span.p:
Release pipeline: moves one cell's branch at a time
to the released commit of main, while that cell is drained

div.style: color: rgb(0, 0, 0) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 360px; text-align: center;

span.p:
Flux in the cell: polls its branch every minute,
verifies the signature, reconciles

div.style: color: rgb(0, 0, 0) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 360px; text-align: center; width: 360px;

span.p:
Cell healthy? Kustomizations Ready · tests through the per-cell host names
back in traffic · SLO and error-rate checks
